feeds.title: Dishin & Dishes
feeds.description: Dishin & Dishes features recipes, gardening, and all things food written by Oklahoma food blogger Katie Johnstonbaugh. Katie is the wife of Mr. Wonderful and a mom to 6 beautiful kids.

feeds.title: Mom Spark
feeds.description: Recipes, travel, social good initiatives, entertainment, crafts/DIY, natural living, blogging advice, fashion, parenting, and decor. Mom Spark was created by Amy Bellgardt. She is a single work-at-home mom of two boys (21 & 13 years) in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

feeds.title: Allyson in Wonderland
feeds.description: Ally of Allyson in Wonderland is a fashion, travel, and lifestyle blogger based out of Oklahoma City. This blog is her visual style story that showcases what to wear and where to wear it. Her goal is to expose readers to unique and accessible fashion ideas, dreamy places, and new beauty products to help inspire them on their own style journeys.

feeds.title: Farm Girl Blog
feeds.description: Faith, marriage, motherhood, farm + ranch life, and a rural lifestyle blog.Kenzie is a Fireman's Wife, Girl Mom, Cowgal, and a Store Owner.

feeds.title: 40corner40 Blog
feeds.description: 40corner40 is a lifestyle blog of Tabitha. It centers around living a possible total wholeness. Its holistic mission is to empower, encourage, build-up, and serve women for greater success in life. Being a migrant, my core mission may closely align with other migrant women from all over the world.

feeds.title: Doctor Mommy, MD
feeds.description: I'm Shelly; curator and author of Doctor Mommy, MD, a wife, doctor, brand-spankin' new mama. My passion is in helping others live their best lives, both physically and emotionally, and I spend my days doing my best to find ways to be mindful and wholehearted in everything I do!

feeds.title: Melissa Beeler Blog
feeds.description: I'm Melissa, the creator of this blog. I'm always looking to connect and help support other mamas and mompreneurs. I have a 3-year-old son Boston, 5-year-old daughter, London, and another baby girl is on the way! I'm the wife of a firefighter and we live in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

feeds.title: Brenda Dalton Blog
feeds.description: I'm Brenda. I'm a native Tulsan and lifestyle blogger, focusing on living a fabulous life as a thirty-something mom with chronic illness.

feeds.title: The Spicyy Life
feeds.description: Everyday mom life & style! I'm Karli - an Air Force wife, a first time mom, an amateur actor, and a family chef.
